column1: # include/ac1/symbols.tsv - address -> name -> C type -> unit for the shared AC1 types.
# Columns: address (0x hex), name, C type, unit (exe, 201..204, fdatNNN).
# C type: data is "T", "T *", "T[N]" or "T[]"; functions are "ret (params)".
# tools/match/ctx.py turns this file into include/ac1/symbols.h (ctx.py gen) and
# match_fn.py reads it with --syms (plain "addr<TAB>name" rows; the extra columns are ignored).
# Overlays 201..204 share one address space, so the unit column decides which binary an
# address belongs to; names are unique across the whole file.
# Function names already in ac1_markup.tsv are repeated here only to give them a C type.
